title: GLtron
tagline: Four lightcycles, one grid, and a trail that kills you as surely as the wall.
summary: GLtron (Andreas Umbach, version 0.70final) is a 3D lightcycle game: you race across a square grid, turn at right angles and try to cut off the other cycles while their trails fill the arena.

The original's single-player game against three computer opponents and its local split-screen games for two or four players are here, with the classic arena, the Dumb/Normal/Strong/MCP bot levels, boosters, wall acceleration and the original score/round rules.

The models, textures, sounds and menus are the original's; the renderer is three.js, the soundtrack is the original Impulse Tracker module rendered to OGG, and the four seats can be human or computer as in the original's Play Settings.
